gal-qcx1zz.desc_en: Time travel, people 100% in costume, and the best projects of the major all in a single night. 📼✨ Between an opening dance straight out of Grease + Pulp Fiction and those who walked away crowned with their Enfocusito, this retro edition only confirmed one thing: every single hour of staying up late editing was totally worth it. 🎞️🍿
gal-qcx1zz.subtitle_en: Awards ceremony at UNITEC... It's our version of the Oscars
